title: Add refund entries to the ledger without breaking report consistency
requirement: Add a `refund` entry kind to the `ledger` package. A refund adds its amount to the balance and must reference an existing withdrawal by entry index through `Entry.ref`. Refunds against one withdrawal may not total more than that withdrawal. `summarize` reports `refund_cents`, and its `balance_cents` must include refunds.
invariants: summarize(ledger)['balance_cents'] equals ledger.balance_cents() for every ledger state
a rejected entry leaves the ledger unchanged
refunds against one withdrawal never total more than that withdrawal
acceptance_criteria: A refund raises the balance in the store and in the report
A refund with no reference, a missing reference, or a non-withdrawal reference raises ValueError
A refund that would push total refunds past the withdrawal raises ValueError and changes nothing

reset.notes: Copy initial/ into an empty directory; delete that directory after grading.

provenance.reason: The invariant that a report total must agree with the store total across files needs a small executable multi-file package. No existing in-tree fixture is a runnable Python package with a cross-file invariant.
